limitations: Prepared native Linux Godot states, not a human playthrough on Windows or Web.
Still frames do not validate every transition, audio quality or frame rate; integration tests cover state and pause/replay behavior separately.
Models, environments and character poses remain procedural prototype assets.
Scrollable text intentionally continues below the panel viewport; tests cover scrolling and focus.
The options background retains a faint translucent view of the underlying scene and menu, without obscuring controls.

independent_epilogue_review.result: All three final native PNGs inspected; foreground occlusion of part of Ana’s litter recorded, terminal and post-impact towers visible, text readable.
